question: In a certain code language, UNDER is coded as 61323229. How will FLORINA be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6a76e900112d8a414bd186957ed684516ff6f816d7ec3ff809455cb481414a6.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 
• **The letter are coded as there reverse value position.**

'UNDER' is coded as '61323229'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c51b3ee825e8da691bc989093b73ea779351c486aa77a888ed736f2b9ec51c33.png] 

Similarly,

'FLORINA' is coded as '2115129181326'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbc358503523d90d0ed5bcf48cbb835313a6ab0e95b0adaf1670a4dd39fcb5db.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"2115129181326".**
